Options:
  -k EXPRESSION  Select tests by name expression
  -m MARKEXPR  Select tests by marker expression
  -x, --exitfirst  Stop after the first failure
  --maxfail NUM  Stop after the specified failure count
  -q, --quiet  Reduce output
  -v, --verbose  Increase output detail
  --collect-only  Collect tests without running them
  --tb STYLE  Select traceback formatting
  --capture METHOD  Select output capture method
  --rootdir DIR  Set the root directory
  -c FILE  Select a configuration file
  -p NAME  Load or disable a plugin
  --basetemp DIR  Select temporary directory
  --durations N  Report slow durations
  --junit-xml PATH  Write an XML report
